bullets.text: In Chennai, a young man tragically died after losing his balance and falling into rainwater accumulated with a live wire.
Severe cyclonic storm Murasu uprooted 12 trees and damaged houses and vehicles across Chennai, causing severe waterlogging.
Heavy rains from Cyclone Murasu caused a four-hour train halt in Ponneri and left passengers stranded, requiring close monitoring by officials.
Plastic waste and garbage accumulation in the Pillemman Temple tank in Taramani, Chennai, are causing severe foul odors.
Light rain and office hours caused heavy traffic congestion near Kamatchi Hospital on the Pallavaram-Thoraipakkam Radial Road in Pallikaranai, trapping an ambulance.
In Thiruvallur district, 61 TASMAC employees were suspended for striking and refusing to open shops over the empty bottle buyback rule.
Thiruvallur Collector S. Kavitha announced that CCTV cameras will be installed to monitor all operations at direct government paddy procurement centers.
Two minors were arrested in Ponneri by local police for stealing a motorcycle belonging to cooking master Mohamed Asif while it was parked on Jeeva Street.
Vultr has launched a 20-megawatt computing cluster powered by AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs in Chennai to expand India's AI infrastructure.
Chennai's data centre capacity is projected to surge nearly seven-fold from 300 MW to 2,300 MW by 2032 with investments exceeding USD 10 billion.
MeitY released the DEPA framework handbook to help institutions securely share data for AI training, which the office should promote.
The DMK IT wing launched severe criticisms on digital platforms, which the political team should monitor closely.
